summary: Implementation plan for simplifying the Reselling pricing & profit system: removing the complex top global calculator panel, displaying Admin's fixed wholesale price (e.g., ৳350), suggested/max resale price (e.g., ৳500), and auto-calculated profit (e.g., ৳150), and allowing resellers to set any selling price within the range (e.g., ৳350–৳500) where the difference is automatically shown as their profit.
